title: Alkyne dichotomy and hydrogen migration in binuclear cyclopentadienylmetal alkyne complexes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6000-6014
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA01410C, Paper
Open Access

Huidong Li, Jinfeng Luo, Haoyu Chen, Ruilin Lu, Yucheng Hu, Huijie Wang, Yanshu Wang, Qunchao Fan, R. Bruce King, Henry F. Schaefer
Low-energy (Me2N)2C2M2(C5H5)2 (M = Ni, Co, Fe) structures have central Mn2C2 tetrahedrane units or separate bridging Me2NC carbyne units. However, low-energy (Me2NC2Me)M2(C5H5)2 and Me2C2M2(C5H5)2 structures exhibit hydrogen migration from the methyl substituent.
